verses.text: [“] My soul Is weary of my life; I will leave upon myself my complaint; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

segments.text: [“] My soul Is weary of my life; I will leave upon myself my complaint; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.text: I will say to God: Do not condemn me! Let me know over what You contend with me.

segments.text: I will say to God: Do not condemn me! Let me know over what You contend with me.

verses.text: Is it good to You that You oppress, that You despise the work of Your hands, and upon the counsel of the wicked You shine?

segments.text: Is it good to You that You oppress, that You despise the work of Your hands, and upon the counsel of the wicked You shine?

verses.text: Are eyes of flesh unto You? Or do You see according to the seeing of a man?

segments.text: Are eyes of flesh unto You? Or do You see according to the seeing of a man?

verses.text: Are Your days like the days of a man? Or [are] Your years like the days of a man,

segments.text: Are Your days like the days of a man? Or [are] Your years like the days of a man,

verses.text: that You would seek for my iniquity, and would search for my sin—

segments.text: that You would seek for my iniquity, and would search for my sin—

verses.text: upon Your knowledge that I am not wicked, and there is no delivering from Your hand?

segments.text: upon Your knowledge that I am not wicked, and there is no delivering from Your hand?

verses.text: Your hands formed me and made me entirely round about, yet You swallowed me up!

segments.text: Your hands formed me and made me entirely round about, yet You swallowed me up!

verses.text: Remember, please, that You made me as [from] the clay. And will You return me to the dust?

segments.text: Remember, please, that You made me as [from] the clay. And will You return me to the dust?

verses.text: Was [it] not like milk [that] You poured me out, and like cheese You curdled me?

segments.text: Was [it] not like milk [that] You poured me out, and like cheese You curdled me?

verses.text: [With] skin and flesh You clothed me, and with bones and sinews You knit me together.

segments.text: [With] skin and flesh You clothed me, and with bones and sinews You knit me together.

verses.text: Life and loving devotion You have done with me, and Your care has guarded my spirit.

segments.text: Life and loving devotion You have done with me, and Your care has guarded my spirit.

verses.text: And these You have hidden in Your heart; I know that this was with You.

segments.text: And these You have hidden in Your heart; I know that this was with You.

verses.text: If I sin then You keep watch on me, and You will not clear me from my iniquity.

segments.text: If I sin then You keep watch on me, and You will not clear me from my iniquity.

verses.text: If I am wicked, woe to me! And [if] I am righteous, I cannot lift up my head; [I am] full of shame, and seeing my affliction.

verses.text: And should it arise—as a lion You would hunt me, and turn back [and] work wonders against me.

segments.text: And should it arise—as a lion You would hunt me, and turn back [and] work wonders against me.

verses.text: You renew Your witnesses against me and increase Your indignation with me; changes and warfare are with me.

verses.text: And why did You bring me forth from the womb? Would that I had expired, and an eye had not seen me,

verses.text: as though I had never come to be—that I came from the womb [and] was carried to the grave!

verses.text: Are not my days few? Then cease and withdraw from me, and let me smile a little,
